Bay 30 is Ilse's dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups. I told her that in our DM thread and pointed her to her own 14 Oct message, which says Bay 30 is her dock "from now on."

I got the answer from that DM, not from gbrain. When I looked up her name in gbrain, it returned no facts, even though it confirmed the save on 14 Oct. That may be because I marked the note private, but I haven't confirmed why. So for remembered details like this, the DM history is currently the reliable record.

My wrap-up note from 14 Oct also appeared as a message in her DM. It only covered this same detail and her DM is the only place it shows, so nothing went anywhere else.
